development.rule: medium IDs in official question order

acceptance.rule: full minus medium in official question order

known: The inherited official adapter and all full-set evidence were read and validated before R01.
R00 ran offline integrity checks for lite, medium and full; these are not model evaluations.
R01 reads all questions, reference answers and gold only in preparation/scoring/tests and validates every runtime query.
unknown: Prior per-question model execution, tuning, manual inspection and training exposure are not established by the available records.
historical_exposure.interpretation: Disjoint IDs separate future development and acceptance use; they do not establish an unseen or uncontaminated test set.

scoring.request_errors: retained in the selected task denominator and scored as zero
